notes: New Trickshot mode (solo): spawn on a 22 m tower over a field of bot targets, some standing, some patrolling; a mid-air hit ends the run and the final killcam replays it, landing without one puts you straight back on top. Maps rebuilt with real surfaces: concrete, asphalt, rusted corrugated steel, riveted steel, planks, bricks and worn painted metal, all with bump maps and world-scaled tiling. Bullet tracers in killcam replays. Diamond camo reverted to the earlier look.
